title: When more measurement is not more evidence

conceptual_spine.stance: Familiar performance metrics are local quantities conditioned on earlier measurement choices and losses; they are not universal proxies for resolution of a declared ecological or evolutionary claim.
conceptual_spine.synthesis: shared conditional structure across the four interacting interfaces
conceptual_spine.core_prediction: Given a predeclared claim and equal-cost measurement expansions, diagnosis of the limiting interface before collecting new data should predict which intervention yields the largest gain in claim resolution.
conceptual_spine.operational_rule: Before collecting more data, ask what distinction the next measurement must create or preserve for the conclusion to change.
